text:
Alex Kim: Quick question — confidential: a team member, Sam, submitted an ADA request for noise sensitivity (sensory). They want to switch to hybrid/remote and request a quieter workspace. Manager worried about coverage & recent performance dip. Anyone handled this?
Priya Patel: Thanks for flagging, Alex. Please do not post medical details in public channels — move to DM or #people-ops private thread. Short answer: yes, we handle this via the interactive accommodation process. Have you filled the intake form? https://redwood/hr/accommodations (internal) :eyes:
Alex Kim: Not yet. I wanted to check what evidence we can/should request, and whether accommodation can be denied because of impact on team.
Priya Patel: You can request documentation to support the need but be careful — ask for verification, not details. Accommodation can't be automatically denied because of inconvenience. We must consider reasonable accommodations and explore alternatives first (quiet room, noise-cancelling headphones, flexible hours, partial remote). If none workable, we document undue hardship. I'll DM you intake packet and the timeline.
Jordan Reyes: Context: Sam's PR throughput fell from ~6->3 in Feb. They missed two sprint goals which affected oncall rotation. We're worried that remote could further hinder async reviews and pairing. If we approve and performance remains low, what's the path?
Priya Patel: Accommodations don't exempt performance expectations. We'll do an interactive plan: trial accommodation window (typically 2-4 weeks), then reassess. If performance remains below bar, we follow standard performance improvement process — objective metrics, support, documented performance plan. But document all steps and accommodations offered.
Marta (HR-bot): POLICY SNIPPET:
```
Redwood ADA Accommodation Process
1) Intake form within 2 business days
2) Interactive discussion within 5 business days
3) Implement reasonable accommodations when possible
4) Reassess performance post-accommodation; PIP may follow if standards unmet
```
Link: https://redwood/policies/ada (internal)
Priya Patel: Next steps I'll take: 1) send intake form to Sam and cc manager, 2) schedule joint 1:1 (HR + manager + Sam) this week, 3) propose accommodations (quiet room reservation, noise-cancelling stipend, hybrid schedule), 4) set 3-week review. Can you confirm manager availability @Jordan?
Jordan Reyes: I can do Wed 2pm or Fri 10am. Wed better. Also, do you have a PIP template I can use if needed?
Priya Patel: Yes — here's the PIP template: https://redwood/templates/pip and a short checklist: doc attached (I'll DM). Also let me know if Sam needs immediate interim accommodations (e.g., move desk) and we'll prioritize.
Alex Kim: Thanks! I'll reach out to Sam privately and get the intake form started. Appreciate the quick guidance :pray:
